review_pass_1.type: separate internal scientific and scope review
checks: Official syllabus and roadmap responsibility mapped to all 11 sections.
Selected textbooks, primary papers and reviews checked for SRY sufficiency, active ovarian pathways, Jost experiments, fly dosage and alternative splicing, worm somatic pathway, avian dosage and TSD.
Corrected hormone figure so testosterone branches separately toward Wolffian and local DHT outcomes; added monotreme exception and WormBook somatic pathway citation.
Recomputed conditional proportion, ratio, threshold crossing, occupancy, logistic values and percentage-point differences. Models labeled hypothetical.
review_pass_1.limitations: Selected accessible abstracts, textbooks and reviews; not external peer review. Current official MPPSC-hosted file not verified.

checks: Saved HTML 14,249 teaching words in 162 distinct paragraphs; no exact overlap with 5.C.03 (13,943 words, 159 paragraphs).
54 initial questions plus two diagram/graph questions; 56 checked option-key-text matches, 14 per answer position.
13 labeled SVGs, 4 tables, 7 worked examples, 20 traps, 15 recall prompts; static links, IDs, ARIA, zoom targets and script parse verified.
Preserved existing reader template and no links to unpublished adjacent nodes.
review_pass_2.limitations: No interactive browser rendering, screen-reader or cross-device test; static inspection only.
